description: Sydney Train Routes is a dataset listed in Transport for NSW Open Data Hub (opendata.transport.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport Open Data Hub. This spatial dataset includes the train lines generated from the shape. txt file in the Sydney Trains GTFS static bundle. Spatial route datasets included in the following formats and will be updated on a monthly basis: - csv - geojson - json - kml - shapefile. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher Transport Open Data Hub. Its tags are GIS, Sydney Train Routes, Sydney Trains, geospatial, route. It offers 7 resource(s) in csv, geojson, json, kml, map. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tfnsw-open-data-hub.
